[[File:Repulsorlift_Harvester.png|thumb|right|The ''Sea Sprite'', a repulsorlift harvester on Kaal]]
'''Repulsorlift harvesters''' were immense hovering factories that floated above the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. They were used to scoop up food from the seas, separate it, preserve it, and package it for sale.<ref name="KC">{{JournalCite|7|The Kaal Connection}}</ref> Repulsorlift harvesters were used on planets such as [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]<ref name="AP">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref> and [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]].<ref name="KC" /> [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] manufactured the [[HV6 Harvester Factory]], and one such unit, the ''[[Bountiful]]'', operated on Ando during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AP" /> During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Tirgee Benyalle]] operated a number of repulsorlift harvesters, including the ''[[Sea Sprite]]''.<ref name="KC" />
